messages:
sophia.ae: Quick ping — Whitestone wants to move from POC -> prod. They're pushing for a bespoke commit to lower TCO. Need guidance before I send counters.

mikael.se: Confirming workload: mostly realtime chat (low latency) + nightly bulk embeddings, correct?

sophia.ae: Correct. Steady ~120M tokens/month, with spikes up to ~600M for peak events. They asked for dedicated pool + eventual private VPC. POC used hosted API.

james.deal-desk: Spell out the ask: percent off, term, committed $ and any add-ons. I'll run margin.

sophia.ae: They requested 45% off list on hosted inference for 12 months with $240k commit (monthly billing). Also want optional Private deployment (3-node reserved pool) as an add-on and a clause to lock pricing unless usage >2x for 2 months.

pricing-bot: Quick calc: 45% off + $240k commit => projected margin ~18% before infra pass-throughs. Private add-on reduces per-token revenue but stabilizes ARR.

james.deal-desk: 18% is below acceptable floor. Finance usually needs >=25% unless we get higher commit/longer term. Ask if they'd take 36% off for 24 months or 12m with $300k+ commit.

sophia.ae: Whitestone prefers 12 months for budgeting flexibility. I can propose two counters — want to confirm KMS/Private fees first.

mikael.se: Security ask: SOC2 required and customer-managed KMS for Private. Also need IP allow-listing and egress controls. Technical KMS surcharge: estimate one-time integration + ~0.5% uplift on per-token for duration. Private pool sizing: 3 reserved GPUs with autoscale burst; we should pass through reserved-node cost in addendum.

james.deal-desk: That helps. Tara/Finance, any room to swallow KMS fee instead of customer?

tara.finance: Finance baseline: hosted discounts floor ~25% unless deal has strong commit or multi-year. 36% could be approved with >=$350k or 24m term. For private, we need to ensure ARR covers reserved GPU depreciation; include a node fee amortized monthly. Early-termination exposure must be limited.

oliver.legal: Legal flag: bespoke pricing needs explicit early-termination taper and credit recovery language. For Private/VPC, we'll add a security appendix and DPA + KMS integration clause. I can draft an addendum but need final numbers for reserved nodes and one-time KMS integration fee.

james.deal-desk: Approval flow: deal-desk margin signoff -> finance -> legal. I can give provisional approval for 36%/24m if finance signs off; otherwise escalate executive approval for 12m higher commit.

sophia.ae: Proposed counters to present: A) 36% off, 24 months, standard private add-on fees, KMS surcharge; B) 12 months, 40% off, $320k commit, with early-exit credit taper. Which do you prefer?

mikael.se: From infra view, counter A is easier (longer term smooths capacity). Counter B adds more risk but higher immediate revenue. KMS one-time ~ $8k engineering effort estimate + token uplift.

pricing-bot: Projection: Counter A => margin ~24%. Counter B => margin ~21% after accounting for early-exit exposure. Both better than initial 18%.

james.deal-desk: I'm fine provisionally with Counter A, subject to tara.finance and oliver.legal signoff on addendum. If they insist on a 12m term, we need $300k+ to consider without exec signoff.

oliver.legal: I'll prepare DPA + addendum and plug in KMS and reserved-node fees once you confirm numbers. Will include early-exit taper language (90% credit year1, 60% year2, prorated thereafter).

tara.finance: Once Sophia posts final price sheet and expected monthly spend cadence, I'll run the detailed margin model and confirm by EOD tomorrow. Remember to include node amortization and KMS one-time in the first invoice.

sophia.ae: I'll assemble the two-counter PDF + spreadsheet and send by EOD. Will call Whitestone to pre-check appetite for 24m. Thanks team :thumbsup:

james.deal-desk: tagging for visibility @tara.finance @oliver.legal. Keeping thread as the approval record.

pricing-bot: deal id WL-2026-091 created and attached. Attach price calc to the thread.
